crossRefs.note: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.
Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, “Surely you are…
So he let him alone. Then she said, “You are a bridegroom of blood,” because of the circumcision.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Zipporah
people.line: Wife of Moses, daughter of Jethro

translations.web: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,
translations.bsb: After Moses had sent back his wife Zipporah, his father-in-law Jethro had received her,
translations.kjv: Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,
translations.asv: And Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her away,
